outcome: Accuracy of fetal CoA diagnosis with and without fetal CMR
cohort: Fetuses with suspected left-sided cardiac obstructions (n=46) and healthy controls (n=5) who underwent fetal cardiac MRI and echocardiography between 2017 and 2022.
finding: While fetal CMR-derived DAo and UV flow measurements did not improve the prenatal diagnosis of left-sided cardiac obstructions, they may help identify fetuses with more severe blood flow compromise across the left side of the heart.
